name: @lifeos/search-service
description: Search Service (Milestone 1): keyword search across whatever objects exist at this point in the build — Core Objects (Folder, Tag, Label), Personal Constitution sub-entities, and AI Memory. Semantic search is deferred until the Vector Database has meaningful content, per the Engineering Roadmap. Owns no database of its own: composes results entirely from the Object Service and AI Memory Service's own HTTP APIs, per the Engineering Roadmap's "internal services never share a database directly — only through service interfaces."
